text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are at a theme park
for a day
of relaxation, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Good grief. I was starting to wonder if we'd make it back alive.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ferris wheels always make my heart
pound out of
my chest.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's not that. I'm just not used to all my

surroundings moving of their own
volition.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer, but how about we pick

something we can enjoy with our feet on
the
ground next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I run through some ideas that don't
involve
getting on a ride. Maybe a
haunted house or a
house of mirrors? I
think our options might be a
bit limited...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Hi, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
Hey now! It's not polite to just run up
and start
bothering people!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm very sorry to bother you! My
daughter's been
a big fan of yours
forever!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind one bit. I'm grateful, if
anything.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hi there. Is it true you've been cheering
for me?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Yes! I like how you're always smiling!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Acute! Let's ride a roller coaster
together! I'm
finally big enough to ride
one!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. A... roller coaster?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's such a sweet invitation, but even the
Ferris
wheel is beyond Wonder Acute's
limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open my mouth to decline in her place,
when...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sure, why not? Let's go get in line.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Really? Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl & Acute
text_block_list.text:
Wheeee!
...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wowowooow! That was so fast! Hey,
Acute! Can
we ride that boat over there
too?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The pirate ship? Sure, let's go for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh! Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl & Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! We're falling! We're falling!
...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I suspect these rides are hard
on
Wonder Acute, her smile never
falters the whole
time. Afterward...

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for spending time
with her.
You really didn't have to!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I was running next to you
when we were
riding all those rides!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, I'm glad you had fun. Make
sure you
get home safe now.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: I will! Bye!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm in trouble, Trainer. My face
won't go
back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess the smile she glued to her face
for that
little girl is stuck on pretty tight.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The little girl told me she likes my smile,

remember?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's the happy memories of
childhood
that help you through difficult
times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute kept up a smile and
endured rides
she doesn't like, all for a
young fan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute kept up a smile and
endured rides
she doesn't like, all for a
young fan.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think you're right. But even if she
forgets, I'm
just glad she had fun today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute smiles gently, and it's
hard not to
be moved by her maturity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like exactly what the doctor
ordered.
To be honest, I don't know that
I can take any
more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lead the exhausted Wonder Acute into
the
shade of a nearby tree, where we
relax for a
while.
